source.source_text: guptaṃ tu paramaṃ divyaṃ kimarthaṃ naravandite | etad vadasva me (?) vāme yathāvidhiranukramāt —

T1.close_translation: "[and]-the-hidden, indeed, the-supreme, the-divine: why [is-it], O-honored-by-men? [and]-this-tell-me (*?), O-Vāmā, [and]-the-method-in-order (*?):" "[Devī:] Hear, O-Bhairava, in-truth (tattvena), the-question, indeed, in-the-supreme-meaning (paramārthataḥ): [and]-the-eight-seats (aṣṭa-pīṭha), indeed, which-are-declared, the-best-among-all-the-seats: [and]-the-there-stood (*?), indeed, [and]-these-all, [and]-the-come-by-their-own-nature (*?): [and]-the-eight-and-eight (*?), the-divine (*?), the-eager-for-the-own-nature-worship (*?): [and]-the-sixty-four-great-terrible (catuḥṣaṣṭi-mahābhīma), the-mistresses-of-all-the-heroes (*?): [and]-by-the-great-yogas (*?), indeed, O-Rudra, [and]-the-...-the-...(*?) [X: "udyuktāḥ" — the-ready], by-the-method (*?):"
